title: Run summary (run_summary.json beside per_question.jsonl)
description: One run: configuration, models, timings, accuracy by category, the retrieval funnel, primary gaps, cascades, reader failure types and the injection audit. All numbers are derived from per_question.jsonl and ingest.jsonl.

config.description: engine config overrides of the arm (from the run manifest)

errata.description: A5: accuracy with and without the errata questions (gold_error, needs_image from analysis/locomo_errata.json); strict drops confirmed entries, incl_borderline also the borderline ones; each has n, n_excluded, accuracy and by_category. Null when no errata file was loaded

n_adversarial.description: A13: LoCoMo cat-5 rows, excluded from n_questions and accuracy

adversarial.description: A13: cat-5 (abstention) n and accuracy, reported apart from the headline; accuracy is null for retrieval-only runs

sufficiency_on_qa_set.description: A12: retrieval-only runs: share of the non-adversarial questions with all gold in context

recall_at_10_hits.description: A12: share of questions with all gold in the engine's final top-10 search hits before neighbour expansion (needs the stage log)

funnel.description: share of questions whose gold evidence survives each stage, per category

oracle.description: accuracy given all gold in context vs not, per category

injection.description: turns, written, text_altered, no_date, date_mismatch, memory_types
